title: Keycloak: MariaDB Connector/J is used to connect applications developed in Java to MariaDB and MySQL databases…
description: A low-severity security vulnerability affects Keycloak versions prior to 26.7.5-r3 related to the use of MariaDB Connector/J, which connects Java applications to MariaDB and MySQL databases. The vulnerability does not impact confidentiality or integrity but may cause limited availability issues. A fix is available in version 26.7.5-r3.
